title: Gateway event
description: One JSON object per AI gateway call. Mirrors EVENT_FIELDS in lakehouse.gateway.contract; answered_by and tokens are null exactly when refused_by_gateway is true.

event_time.description: When the gateway handled the call (UTC), ISO 8601 with an offset.

request_id.description: Opaque per-call identifier; never a GUID.

session.description: Named per live session, or 'replay' for generated events that never feed a published figure.

caller.description: A label for who called; raw object IDs never leave the gateway.

answered_by.description: The backend that answered; null when the gateway refused the call.

tokens.description: Tokens consumed; null when the gateway refused the call.

latency_ms.description: Elapsed time in the gateway, milliseconds.
